answer: Model agents as a vouch graph. Each epoch, 10 seed agents picked at an audited summit of established miners release 8-hop random walks that wander only along vouch edges; the vertex where a walk ends gets one credit, and an agent needs 3 credits to earn rewards. Walks enter a sybil ring only through its few attack edges, so an attacker running 1,000 fakes behind 2 edges earns roughly what 2 honest agents get. Weakness: bought vouches add attack edges. Fix: walks skip edges younger than 5 epochs and each agent may add at most 2 vouches per epoch.
